identity: AMP H5 only; next single-component experiment, not new manuscript or method claim

sources.verified: Das et al., Accelerated antimicrobial discovery via deep generative models and molecular dynamics simulations, Nature Biomedical Engineering 5:613–623, published 11 March 2021; publisher links official IBM code. Author correction exists 28 June 2021.
sources.access: Publisher bibliographic record/abstract/code availability; detailed methods below from author manuscript and official code, not claimed publisher full-text access.

sources.verified: Compares beta-VAE and WAE; VAE KL anneals 0 to .03 or 1; separate heldout reconstruction and prior sample evaluations. Aggregate posterior z density fitted by GMM; paper uses 10 posterior samples per training example and 100 diagonal components selected on heldout likelihood.
sources.boundary: Large additional unlabeled data, optimization search, recurrent autoregressive decoder and filtering chain differ from H5; do not copy quantitative optimum or call H5 a reproduction.

sources.verified: Calls model sample_z=1, separates reconstruction and z_regularizer; beta=utils.anneal; loss=reconstruction+beta*z_regu_loss plus optional variance terms.
sources.boundary: H5 already trains on stochastic posterior; adding another noise term or whole WAE changes more than KL schedule. Optional variance penalties will not be transferred.

sources.verified: Separately invokes reconstruction from sample_q=max and sampled q; decoder beam/categorical settings are separate decisions.
sources.boundary: Mean decode does not estimate random posterior reconstruction. H5 J/PAD differs from recurrent beam decoder.

sources.verified: mogQ fits sklearn GaussianMixture to mu+exp(.5*logvar)*epsilon; gaussianQ uses Cov(mu)+diag(mean(exp(logvar))).
sources.boundary: Official repository mechanism, not proof gaussianQ was the paper final method. H5 field is log-sigma, requiring exp(2*logs) for variance. Full replacement remains a source-model change and is not admitted now.

sources.verified: Müller et al., Recurrent Neural Network Model for Constructive Peptide Design, JCIM 2018 58(2):472–479, helical AMP sequence-generation study.
sources.access: ACS search record and author abstract; direct publisher full text unavailable.

sources.verified: LSTM input and recurrent dropout per layer, categorical objective and validation tracking; dropout=0.1 produces layerwise .1/.2 in author implementation.
sources.boundary: H5 PyTorch inter-layer dropout alone is not this exact mechanism; changed regularization would be a separate baseline adaptation, not H5 innovation.

sources.verified: Expected reconstruction under learned approximate posterior q_phi is estimated through reparameterized samples. q_phi is not the intractable true posterior p_theta.
sources.boundary: A decoder evaluated at latent mean does not generally equal expected decoder distortion; finite K is Monte Carlo, not proof of zero gap.

sources.locations: sections2.1–2.2, Theorem5 and discussion of characteristic kernels
sources.verified: MMD is an RKHS mean-embedding discrepancy; distribution-identifying conclusions require sufficient kernel richness and statistical test assumptions.
sources.boundary: H5 finite421-feature linear MMD measures differences of those feature means. Resampling existing outputs does not create independent trained models or a p-value automatically.

public_code_version_limit: Read mutable master URLs on this turn; GitHub commit API/page failed. No official code installed or executed; no immutable commit asserted.

comparative_candidates.minimal_change: Constant density-KL beta=1 versus linear warm-up to the same final beta=1; keep CE21, architecture, decoder J, scaler, data and all optimizers fixed.
comparative_candidates.why: Tests an optimization/regularization tradeoff within the existing VAE, without assuming DDPM is the bottleneck. Schedule is a mature method adaptation.

comparative_candidates.precedent: Das/CLaSS 2021 Q density plus official mogQ/gaussianQ
comparative_candidates.minimal_change: Freeze CE encoder/decoder and replace learned source distribution with train-only aggregate decoder-z density.
comparative_candidates.why: B empirical posterior did not reduce dev MMD in both terminals; stochastic heldout decoder pathway and distribution sensitivity still unresolved. GMM dimension/component choices add fitting opportunities with only279 rows.

comparative_candidates.minimal_change: One explicitly implemented dropout mechanism while holding AR architecture/loss/data/schedule fixed.
comparative_candidates.why: Existing AR overfit means this remains an adequacy issue, but it diagnoses baseline training rather than posterior-path damage. No claim H5 beats a strong AR will be admitted.

RMS_admission.required: Independent complete all-train279/dev41 R/M/S same-checkpoint diagnosis, K=8 fixed posterior draws (maximum8), identical legal J/PAD, original nonPAD target positions, all failures retained. A train32 donor subset alone is insufficient to qualify the all-dev gate.
RMS_admission.R: Original sequence target after verified preprocessing/readout identity; representation roundtrip error separately reported.
RMS_admission.M: Deterministic encoder-mean path through every actual downstream posterior transform; if nonlinear posterior flow is present, transformed base mean is not generally final posterior mean. Native prior flow must not be inserted into the posterior decoder route.
RMS_admission.S: K learned-q approximate posterior samples, complete actual decoder path; not true Bayes posterior.
RMS_admission.per_sequence_statistic: delta_i = accuracy_nonPAD(M_i,x_i) - (1/K)*sum_k accuracy_nonPAD(S_ik,x_i). Primary gap is unweighted mean delta_i over dev41; train279 and terminal strata separate. This is neither residue-weighted micro nor supported-AA macro.
RMS_admission.resource_trigger: mean delta on complete dev41 >=0.05. This user-proposed5pp is only a resource-allocation threshold, not significance or proof KL causes damage.
RMS_admission.failure_or_incomplete: Missing full dev S, any unresolved route/target/shape mismatch, incomplete slots, or a mean gap below5pp => no new VAE/DDPM training under this conditional protocol.
RMS_admission.interpretation: S worse than M supports examining stochastic pathway scale/robustness; both bad supports broader representation/information loss; similar M/S weakens posterior-noise explanation. None uniquely identifies DDPM.

conditional_protocol.control: Frozen CE21 constant beta1 trained1000; read-only historical control, no claim new randomized replication.
conditional_protocol.candidate_schedule: beta(u)=min(1,u/500), updates u=1..1000; final500 updates at beta1. 500-update choice is explicit H5 adaptation, not an optimal setting from the AMP paper.
conditional_protocol.budget: At most one new VAE1000+own train re-encoding+own DDPM1000; CPU1thread serial. Retain frozen phase caps VAE1920s,DDPM1020s,totaltrain2940s,generation1800s. Prior observed complete comparable model jobs ~2868–2878s are evidence of feasibility, not guaranteed runtime. No retries, second beta, endpoint extension or best-dev selection.
conditional_protocol.seeds: For matched deterministic-stream mechanism comparison inherit init/shuffle/VAE222,DDPM322,generation422/423,16 attempts per terminal. Admit only after exact RNG/batch coupling and no extra noise consumption are verified. These are common random inputs, not independent model replicas.
conditional_protocol.evaluation: All existing generated metrics/denominators/negative outcomes; same K=8 R/M/S per-sequence distortion after training, plus micro/macro/length/exact summaries. Train and dev reported separately, no test. Each new latent representation must use its own newly trained DDPM; never plug into old DDPM.
failure_criteria: Any incomplete/numerically invalid job: engineering fail, retain slots, do not promote.

Primary reconstruction hypothesis unsupported if new dev mean stochastic accuracy fails to improve by5pp versus constant-beta control, or the M−S gap fails to shrink; improvement of M alone is insufficient.

End-to-end benefit unsupported unless fixed both-terminal dev MMD decreases relative to CE control and valid5/48 denominators, exact-copy/nearest and all remaining metrics are reported; mixed metrics prevent overall superiority claim. No revised thresholds after seeing results.
A favorable single-fit pilot still does not establish novelty, general superiority, strong-AR superiority, statistical significance or activity.
conditional_protocol.fairness: Same fixed update/configuration opportunity for CE control and candidate; new one-candidate opportunity and diagnostic-informed choice disclosed. AR fixed terminal-LSTM remains same-information contextual baseline, with known overfit and unequal real compute disclosed. Cannot claim strong-baseline victory without a separate predeclared balanced baseline adequacy comparison.
conditional_protocol.no_trigger_priorities: Do not restart VAE/DDPM. Preserve residue-class and per-sequence error profile, train/dev homology and rare-AA support limitations, target/PAD information audit. These are evidence about representation/data coverage; no external-data addition or resplit performed.
